title: Stock Not Stack
style: Minimal cold-down tempo in alt-R&B with clipped kick, sparse sub pulses, and a two-note ostinato that repeats like a warning; verse stays stripped to voice and bare percussion, pre-chorus opens with thin low synth haze, chorus lands on a tight mantra with doubled lead and faint gang unison on the anchor phrase. Tiny reverse swells between lines, tape hiss blooms into the drop, then a final chorus pulls even emptier. Intimate close-mic vocal, dry and severe, with short delay throws on the last word of each hook., simple, minimal
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
You keep saying stack.
I don’t need another stack.
I need a stock.
One thing. Held.
Not built.
Not layered.
Not promised.
Same grim grin.
Same sickle.

[Chorus]
I want the stock
One thing. Held.
I want the stock
Not built, not built
I want the stock
One thing. Held.
I want the stock
Hold it still

[Verse 2]
You gave me stack again.
Same conversation.
Same grim grin.
Same sickle.
I don’t want the stack.
I want the stock.
One line.
One thing.
Held.

[Pre-Chorus]
Exactly.
I asked for stock.
You heard stack.
You heard stack.
I said one thing.
You made it many.
You made it many.

[Chorus]
I want the stock
One thing. Held.
I want the stock
Not built, not built
I want the stock
One thing. Held.
I want the stock
Hold it still

[Bridge]
Understood.
No.
You don’t.
Understood.
No.
You don’t.

[Chorus]
I want the stock
One thing. Held.
I want the stock
Not built, not built
I want the stock
One thing. Held.
I want the stock
Hold it still
